summary: 400 VDC half-bridge leg: 2 × C3M0060065K (TO-247-4 Kelvin), UCC21520DW, 2 × MGJ2D051505SC, 30 A bus

pairs.why: IEC 62368-1 / IEC 60664-1 insulation coordination (drive standard IEC 61800-5-1 not tabulated in pkg/safety). Working voltage: DC bus 450 V max; the high-side gate supply rides 15 V above the switch node (floating island VDDA/KS_H/G_H/OUTA), so the highest HV-side copper is 465 V DC, 535 V peak with the 520 V switching overshoot. Clearance: transient declared mains at 400 V, OVC II → Table F.1 (300–600 V) 4000 V; reinforced → 6000 V → F.2 5.5 mm (procedure 1: 1.6 × 535 = 856 V → 0.2 mm). Creepage: 465 V → F.4 PD2 MG III 4.65 → 4.7 mm basic, 9.4 mm reinforced. UCC21520DW rows 7.29 mm and the MGJ2 input/output pins 5.94 mm are ≥ 5.5 mm but < 9.4 mm → 1 mm slots under U1, U2, U3.
